result.topic_en: Gauss expresses a, b, c of the arithmetic-geometric mean through theta series in x, states the AGM relations, gives x as a limit and log x via the AGM, and describes an algorithm (iterated tangent transformation) for computing the elliptic integral argument theta, with theta-series expressions for tan of the intermediate angles.
result.transcription:
Math 25   [Abschrift]   [-47d-] 11   (62)
$a = \mu(1+2xx+2x^8+2x^{18}+\text{etc.})^2 \quad = \mu f x$
$b = \mu(1-2xx+2x^8+2x^{18}-\text{etc.})^2 \quad = \mu f i x$
$c = \mu(x^{\frac12}+x^{\frac92}+x^{\frac{25}{2}}+\text{etc.})^2 \quad = \mu$
$aa - bb = 16cc$
$a+b=2a', \ ab = b'b', \ cc = a'c', \ a-b = 8c'$ &c.

$x$ ist die Grenze von $\frac{c}{a}, \sqrt{(\frac{c'}{a'})}, \sqrt[4]{\frac{c''}{a''}}, \sqrt[8]{\frac{c'''}{a'''}} \ldots$
Ferner ist das ar. geom. Mittel zwischen $a$ u. $4c$ $= -\frac{\mu\pi}{2\log x}$
$= \nu$. Es ist also $\log x = -\frac12 \frac{\mu\pi}{\nu}$.   $\text{Log}\frac{k\pi}{2} = 9.83390\,41884$

Setzt man $\sqrt{(aa\,[-\sin-]\sin T^2 + bb\cos T^2)} = \Delta$
$\int\frac{dT}{\Delta} = \frac{\theta}{\mu}$
so erhält man $\theta$ durch folgenden Algorithmus

$\text{tg}\,T.\sqrt{\frac{a}{b}} = \text{tg}\,T'$   Dann ist $\theta = T^{\infty}$.
$\text{tg}\,2T'\sqrt{\frac{a'}{b'}} = \text{tg}\,2T''$
$\text{tg}\,4T''\sqrt{\frac{a''}{b''}} = \sqrt{4T'''}$ [?]
$\text{tg}\,8T'''\sqrt{\frac{a'''}{b'''}} = \sqrt{8T^{\text{iv}}}$ [?]
etc.
Man hat ferner
$\text{tg}\,\frac12 T = \frac{x^{\frac14}\sin\frac12\theta - x^{\frac94}\sin\frac32\theta + x^{\frac{25}{4}}\sin\frac52\theta - \text{etc}}{x^{\frac14}\cos\frac12\theta + x^{\frac94}\cos\frac32\theta + x^{\frac{25}{4}}\cos\frac52\theta + \text{etc.}}$
$\text{tg}\,T' = \frac{x^{\frac12}\sin\theta - x^{\frac92}\sin3\theta + x^{\frac{25}{2}}\sin5\theta - \text{etc}}{x^{\frac12}\cos\theta + x^{\frac92}\cos3\theta + x^{\frac{25}{2}}\cos5\theta + \text{etc}}$
$\text{tg}\,2T'' = \frac{x\sin2\theta - x^9\sin6\theta + x^{25}\sin10\theta - \text{etc}}{x\cos2\theta + x^9\cos6\theta + x^{25}\cos10\theta + \text{etc}}$
